definitions.gloss: day and night, around the clock
definitions.explanation: Daytime and nighttime together, often implying continuous activity without rest. Used to emphasize that something goes on without stopping.

examples.japanese: {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work regardless of day or night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{稼働|かどう}している→稼働する：19633_kadousuru⟧。
examples.english: The factory operates in day and night shifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}{隊|たい}→救助隊：23912_kyuujotai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In the disaster-stricken area, rescue teams continue search operations around the clock.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the set phrase {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず (regardless of day or night). Also used as a modifier: {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧ (day-night shift rotation), {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ (reversed sleep schedule). A formal word; in casual speech, ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of day or night
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: day-night shift
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧: reversed day-night cycle
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}{兼行|けんこう}: marching day and night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日夜|にちや}→日夜：03130_nichiya⟧: day and night (similar, slightly more common)
- ⟦{終日|しゅうじつ}→終日：13807_shuujitsu⟧: all day long
